data.title: Application & Document Reviews
data.subtitle: Understand what went wrong. Fix what comes next. Get clarity, answers, and a path forward for your immigration file.
data.intro_description: Immigration refusals, unclear eligibility, or complex IRCC requests can be overwhelming. Our review services help you understand the reason behind a decision, analyze what needs to change, and guide your next steps. Whether it's a GCMS notes review, NOC code verification, a procedural fairness letter (PFL), or past refusal, Velox Immigration gives your case the attention it deserves.
data.what_we_offer_intro: We help you make sense of complex files and build a stronger case:

what_we_offer_items.title: GCMS Notes Request & Analysis
what_we_offer_items.description: GCMS (Global Case Management System) notes are the official IRCC officer's remarks on your application. We submit the access-to-information request, retrieve your file, and provide a plain-language explanation of what went wrong—and how to fix it in your reapplication.

what_we_offer_items.title: NOC Code Review & Guidance
what_we_offer_items.description: Incorrect or mismatched NOC codes are a common reason for PR refusals. We help you choose and justify the correct National Occupation Classification (NOC) code based on your actual duties and responsibilities—not just your job title.

what_we_offer_items.title: Procedural Fairness Letter (PFL) Responses
what_we_offer_items.description: If IRCC has concerns about your admissibility, fraud, misrepresentation, or qualification, they may issue a PFL. We draft a detailed and legally sound response backed by evidence, clarification, and case law if necessary.

what_we_offer_items.title: Refusal Review & Reapplication Strategy
what_we_offer_items.description: A refusal isn't the end of the road. We analyze your decision letter, review the submitted application, and recommend whether to appeal, request reconsideration, or submit a stronger reapplication.

data.what_you_need_to_apply:
Depending on the type of review service, you may need:

  • A copy of your refusal letter or IRCC communication
  • Submitted application package (or access credentials)
  • IRCC application number or UCI
  • Current or proposed NOC code and job duties
  • Any received PFL notice and supporting documentation
  • Signed consent form for GCMS access (IMM 5744)

We guide you through gathering what's needed and offer clear timelines and next steps.

faq_items.question: What are GCMS notes?
faq_items.answer: GCMS (Global Case Management System) notes are internal IRCC officer records. They reveal the real reasons for approval, refusal, or delay.

faq_items.question: Can I access GCMS notes on my own?
faq_items.answer: Only if you are a Canadian citizen or PR—or working with a representative like us who can request them on your behalf.

faq_items.question: Do PFLs mean a guaranteed refusal?
faq_items.answer: No. It's an opportunity to respond before a decision is finalized. A strong reply can save your application.

faq_items.question: Can a wrong NOC code really lead to refusal?
faq_items.answer: Yes. NOC mismatch is a major reason for Express Entry or PNP refusal, especially if your job duties don't align.

faq_items.question: Is it better to reapply or appeal?
faq_items.answer: It depends. We'll review your case to determine whether a reapplication, reconsideration, or appeal is the best next move.

faq_items.question: What is the processing time for GCMS?
faq_items.answer: GCMS timelines are controlled by IRCC and ATIP offices. We monitor every stage of the process on your behalf.
